ground_truth.note: No incident or independently reviewed alert labels are available. Alert counts are not true positives; false-alert rate, precision, recall, and detection latency cannot be measured.

data.row_filter: non-null date_received and non-null grouping keys

method.temporal_safety: current week excluded from baseline; each week's family uses prior counts only

severity.low: alert passed detector thresholds but is below medium criteria
severity.warning: statistical alert magnitude only; not incident severity or confirmed risk
